summary: Tested PipsEvo backend (15 pytest cases) and frontend critical flows. Backend 14/15 passing (1 failure was test-side email case assertion). Frontend: landing, register, login, onboarding (4 steps), sidebar nav (all 9 items), logout all work. Add Account modal inputs not reachable via data-testid within timeout — modal may not open or testids are on wrapper elements only.
